claims: Austin Wells is a New York Yankees catcher.
Austin Wells is representing the Dominican Republic in the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
Austin Wells qualifies to represent the Dominican Republic through his Dominican mother.
Austin Wells secured a 10-0 walk-off mercy rule win over South Korea in the quarterfinals with a three-run home run on March 13, 2026.
The win sent the Dominican Republic to the semifinals.
Wells hit a 374-foot three-run walk-off homer to defeat South Korea.
The home run marked the Dominican Republic’s 14th home run of the tournament.
Austin Wells was born in Arizona.
Austin Wells stated he 'feels more Dominican every day'.
Austin Wells' performance helped Team DR tie the WBC record for home runs in a single tournament.
